senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (तेजति)
To guard, to cherish, to defend or protect.

m. (-जः)
1 Sharpness, pungency.
2 Sharpness of a weapon.
3 Brilliancy.
4 Spirit.
E.
तिज to sharpen, affix घञ्: see तेजस्.

n. (-नं)
1 A bambu.
2 Enlightening, making splendid or polished.
3 Sharpening.
f. (-नी)
1 A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides.)
2 Heartpea.
E.
तिज to sharpen, &c. affix ल्युट्.

m. (-कः)
A kind of reed, (Saccharum sara.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-त्रं)
The leaf of the Laurus cassia.
E.
तेज sharp, pungent, and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-लः)
The francoline partridge.
E.
तेज sharpness, ल what gets.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Sharp, pungent.
2 Sharp as a weapon.
3 Bright.
4 Spirited, energetic.
f. (-ती)
An aromatic plant, (Pothos officinalis): see गजपिप्पली.
E.
तेज sharpness, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-जाः)
A name of Agni or fire.
n. (-जः)
1 Splendour, light, lustre.
2 Dignity, consequence.
3 Strength, power.
4 Ardour, spirit, energy.
5 Semen virile.
6 Fresh butter.
7 Impatience, inability to bear or put up with.
8 Gold.
9 Bile, [] the bilious humour.
10 Marrow, the brain, &c.
11 Fame, glory.
12 Sharpness, (metallic.)
13 Pungency.
14 Heat.
15 Bodily vigour.
16 Vivacity.
E.
तिज to sharpen or polish, affix असुन्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Illuminating, making bright.
2 Sharpening, whetting.
3 Invigorating, tonic.
E.
तेजस् light, &c. and कर what makes.

mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि)
1 Famous, celebrated.
2 Splendid, &c. see the preceding.
f. (-स्विनी)
Heartpea: see ज्योतिष्मती.
E.
तेजस् splendour, &c. विनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sharpened, whetted, polished, burnished.
2 Excited, invigorated, stimulated.
E.
तिज to sharpen, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Very bright or splendid.
2 Vigorous, powerful.
E.
तेजस्, and इष्ठन् aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Very bright, radiant, splendid.
2 Very powerful or vigorous.
E.
तेजस्, and ईयसुन् aff.

m. (-न्थः)
A tree, (Premna spinosa): see गणिकारी.
E.
तेजस् fire, light, and मन्थ friction; the friction of the wood engendering flame.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Luminous, brilliant, consisting or made of light.
E.
तेजस्, मयट् made of.

n. (-पं)
1 The supreme spirit.
2 The nature of light, &c.
E.
तेजस् light (divine), रूप form.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Pungent.
2 Sharp.
3 Bright.
4 Energetic.
f. (-ती)
1 A plant bearing a fruit resembling pepper: see गजपिप्पली.
2 A kind of pepper, (Piper chavya, Rox.)
E.
तेजस् pungency, मतुप् aff.

n. (-त्तं)
Superior brilliancy or power.
E.
तेजस्, and वृत्त being.
